title: Tianning Temple Pagoda, Beijing
summary: The Tianning Temple Pagoda in Xicheng District, Beijing, is a solid octagonal brick pagoda with thirteen levels of eaves, built from 1119 to 1120 under the Liao dynasty. The Beijing tourism bureau gives its height as 57.8 metres; Beijing Postcards calls it over 900 years old, from when the city was the Liao southern capital.

uncertainty.note: The Beijing tourism bureau says built from 1119 to 1120. End is the present.
